_note: Marine character creation (Josiah 2026-11-06). Every marine gets the base training; a role adds Zomboid B42's own job boosts on top (where a role mixes jobs, a skill both give takes the larger). Skills cap at 10. Traits: this many picks from this list, no costs, no negatives.

roles.name: Rifleman
roles.description: The backbone of the purge. Steady aim, fast reloads, never rattled by a horde.

roles.name: Corpsman
roles.description: The squad medic. Patches bites and bullet wounds in the field and treats others faster.

roles.name: Combat engineer
roles.description: Builds the base. Walls, wiring, welding and fortifications go up fastest under this marine.

roles.name: Motor transport
roles.description: Keeps the convoy rolling. Repairs, salvages and hotwires the squad's vehicles.

roles.name: Marksman
roles.description: Picks off targets from range and reads tracks to find the next nest.

roles.name: Pointman
roles.description: First through the door. Quiet, quick and hard to catch.

roles.name: Radio operator
roles.description: Holds the command net. The only marine who can call in an air strike.

roles.name: Logistics
roles.description: Keeps the squad fed. Cooks, farms and butchers so the base can last.
